authors: J. Bai, R. Song, J. Fan, Y. Jiao, J. Zhao, S. Jia, G. Raithel
title: Quantum defects of nFJ levels of Cs Rydberg atoms
method: microwave spectroscopy of laser-excited cold Cs (n+2)D5/2 atoms, state-selective field ionization, zero-field extrapolation
uncertainty: statistical in parentheses (0.9-3.9 kHz); 1 kHz systematic each (dc electric, magnetic) added in quadrature in the analysis
caveats: intervals only; need nD5/2 term values (e.g. Shen2024) to place the nF levels
